name: plan-pressure-tests
description: Four reader skills that pressure-test a plan somebody already wrote — its assumptions, its feasibility against your tree, its claims and its cut order — each refusing the judgment it cannot ground.

skills.name: assumption-audit
skills.line: Grade the assumptions a plan rests on — SUPPORTED only with a file:line, a command's real output, or a page fetched this session; everything else is UNTESTED.

skills.name: feasibility-read
skills.line: Read a plan against this repository — what the tree supports at file:line, what searches came back empty with their patterns, and the unknowns. No estimate.

skills.name: rfc-review
skills.line: Review a design document for the comments that would change it — CONTRADICTED needs a file:line, HOLDS never rests on the document, and every drop is counted.

skills.name: scope-cut
skills.line: Order scope cuts by dependency read out of the import graph, every edge with its file:line — never by value, and no cut called safe without a named consumer.
